name: nearest_access_divergence
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Frozen nearest-category distance excess: median dots, interquartile thick bars and5th–95th percentile thin bars. These are distribution summaries, not confidence intervals or same-object route circuity.

name: association_accessibility
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Complete-case MEW adjusted observational associations, not causal effects or predictive importance. Rail/bus Euclidean predictors use km, walking uses minutes and opportunities use log(1+count); coefficient magnitudes across different units are not rankings. HC3 intervals shown;9,999-replication restricted Webb results are in the table. Uniform10% eligibility is a disclosed post-observation amendment.

name: heldout_feature_contributions
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Existing heldout XGBoost MEW contributions only; no new SHAP calculation or model fit. Ten encoded terms selected for display by across-city mean magnitude; this does not change the model. Unavailable encodings remain missing rather than zero. Each term’s actual support is in the table. Correlated E/W attribution is descriptive, not causal.

name: robustness_contrasts
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Every registered predictive family: paired MW−M0 point changes and frozen95% geographic-composition stability ranges. N/A denotes native density checks inapplicable to Copenhagen/Oslo; no value is filled. Samples and measurement definitions differ across rows, so this is not an absolute-score ranking or pass/fail test.

name: transfer_accessibility_gains
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: All six directional accessibility-versus-baseline point contrasts. Same target observations within every comparison; negative values favour accessibility. These correlated directional results are not pooled into an independent significance test.

name: transfer_prediction_diagnostics
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Saved XGBoost MEW predictions versus actual relative log price in all six directions. Only aggregate rectangular bins with n≥5 are displayed; every target row remains in full metrics. Shared axes; diagonal is perfect relative prediction. No row export, target fitting, smoothing or recalibration.

name: residual_spatial_diagnostics
reason: Useful diagnostic/complementary evidence; avoids duplicating the main narrative
takeaway: Frozen8-nearest-neighbour/499-permutation diagnostics for observed outcomes and primary OOF residuals. City metric CRSs retained. Material OLS MW residual dependence triggered the registered spatial-error association sensitivity in each city; prediction gains are not a claim of independent residuals.
